```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Plot sales by product and size
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='product', hue='size', data=coffee_sales)
plt.title('Coffee Sales by Product and Size')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Size')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
